description: Lightweight resource snapshot embedded in scheduling and workflow models.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable resource identifier within the source and tenant scope.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Display name captured at the time the reference was created.

members.name: ResourceType
members.description: Optional resource type, for example person, team, room, or equipment.

members.name: Color
members.description: Optional color token or sanitized CSS color used for resource labels and timelines.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional provider/source discriminator for applications with multiple resource sources.

members.name: TenantId
members.description: Optional tenant, workspace, or application scope identifier.

members.name: FromResource
members.description: Creates a reference snapshot from a full resource model.
